title: BUGFIX — cmd-gate.ts: use readRealPosts() in cmdStreak/cmdPace/cmdGateSim to exclude dry-runs
description: cmdStreak(), cmdPace(), cmdGateSim() were using readLines(manual-posts.jsonl) which includes dry-run posts. This inflates streak counts, pace calculations, and gate simulations. Fix: import readRealPosts from shared and replace all 4 occurrences. Dry-run post methods: 'browser-post-dry', 'batch-browser-dry'.
